## Domain (maidsofhonolulu.com)

Registered at GoDaddy (account held by the former owner, Arun Savara / Mira's Cleaning Service — Dan should have it transferred to his own account). **Live on Netlify since Sept 21 2026:** nameservers changed at GoDaddy from Cloudflare to Netlify DNS (`dns1-4.p01.nsone.net`). Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).

Let's Encrypt cert auto-provisioned; `www` and `http` redirect to `https://maidsofhonolulu.com`. DNS zone (Netlify → Team → DNS) holds the two NETLIFY records plus two TXT records on `@`:

- `google-site-verification=Gn5L0sDwHf-oFXEA8nDbLbJZlw86NTuyIj-QfAuXi7Y` (pre-existing)
- `google-site-verification=M9xXHSgPnASNQazWZTPzFOx-vpJBVIkIoGh7h7o_nXk` (Search Console, Sept 2026; also a meta tag on `index.html`)

Rollback (old WordPress site): set GoDaddy nameservers back to `anna.ns.cloudflare.com` / `tim.ns.cloudflare.com`. No MX records (email is gmail.com).
